{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-1c8958c4.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [(y - minr, x - minc, color) for y, x in cells]
            height = max(y for y, x, _ in shape) + 1
            objects.append((minc, minr, shape, height))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    for _, _, shape, height in objects:
        for dy, dx, color in shape:
            y, x = top + dy, left + dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        top += height - 1
        left += 1
    return out
"
}
